svg.title: Journey: 2011 curiosity, taking games apart on a slow Core 2 Duo; 2013 learning how games defend themselves, memory, processes and the kernel; 2015 training ground, self-taught coding on a phone in Termux; 2016 founded Sasori Ltd game studio; 2017 trading systems; 2019 Ytteria Studios white-hat group; 2023 shipped WILD HAT arcade game under EC Technologies and started open source on GitHub; now self-hosted lab and products
svg.text: $ git log --reverse --since=2011
Curiosity
Started on a slow Core 2 Duo with 4 GB of RAM, taking browser and
PC games apart to see how they worked. Memory editing taught me numbers.
Why it breaks
Went from breaking games to asking how they defend themselves.
Learned about memory, processes and the kernel underneath.
Training ground
Self-taught: reading, studying, testing. Coding on a phone in Termux,
modding apps and games, and building my first real apps.
Sasori Ltd
Founded a game studio as CEO. Shipped games in Unity, Unreal Engine
and Construct 3 for companies in China, until 2018.
Trading systems
Started building automated trading bots and market signal tools.
Still running and improving them today.
Ytteria Studios
White-hat security group with researchers from Russia, Korea,
China, the Philippines and Thailand.
Studios & open source
Shipped WILD HAT under EC Technologies, one of several small studios,
and started publishing on GitHub: scripts, trading tools and more.
now
Lab + products
Self-hosted sites, Go services, Flutter apps and a Vulkan LLM
engine, all running on my own hardware.
